The Business

I run Stitched by Manwe, a small sewing service in Tempe focused on straightforward alterations, clothing repairs, and simple upcycles. The service is for students, friends, families, and anyone looking to get more wear out of the clothes they already own.

Alongside my engineering studies, sewing gives me another way to work directly with materials, construction, and fit. The business brings that hands-on practice into everyday clothing: adjusting a garment, repairing damage, or restyling an existing piece.

Sewing Services

Tops

Cropping and shortening tops, taking in sides, and adjusting sleeve length or width.

Bottoms

Hemming, waist take-ins, and side adjustments to improve the fit of existing garments.

Clothing Repairs

Seam repairs, small tear repairs, patching, and button replacement to keep clothing in use.

Upcycles & Simple Customs

T-shirt restyles, converting pants into shorts, and simple garment upcycles or custom pieces.

Business Launch

The announcement and service guide shared when I introduced the business on Instagram in September 2026.
